proof_body:
by
  intro A _ _ _
  have e : Finset.univ.filter (fun f : A → Bool => ¬ Function.Surjective f) = {fun _ => true, fun _ => false} := by
    ext f
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro hf
      by_contra hne
      simp only [not_or] at hne
      apply hf
      intro b
      cases b
      · by_contra hb
        apply hne.1
        funext x
        by_contra hx
        exact hb ⟨x, by simpa using hx⟩
      · by_contra hb
        apply hne.2
        funext x
        by_contra hx
        exact hb ⟨x, by simpa using hx⟩
    · rintro (rfl | rfl) hs
      · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs false
        simp at hx
      · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs true
        simp at hx
  have hc := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (A → Bool))) (fun f => Function.Surjective f)
  have h2 : ({fun _ => true, fun _ => false} : Finset (A → Bool)).card = 2 := by
    apply Finset.card_pair
    intro h
    obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty A›
    have := congrFun h x
    simp at this
  rw [e, h2, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool] at hc
  exact hc
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Nonempty A], (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : A → Bool => Function.Surjective f)).card + 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card A
